# END FILE TYPE

End a FILE TYPE definition and read the file.

## Syntax

```text
END FILE TYPE.
```

## Example

```text
FILE TYPE MIXED RECORD=recid 1-2.
RECORD TYPE 23.
DATA LIST /sex 5 age 6-7.
END FILE TYPE.
```

`statscraft help END FILE TYPE` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
